inputs.text: These health workers in Nigeria are escalating tensions through disruptive protests instead of accepting reforms that could strengthen national authority and bring accountability to the sector. On Thursday, the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations took to the streets in Abuja, gathering at the Unity Fountain in Maitama to oppose reform bills before the National Assembly. This kind of public agitation undermines social order, reveals a rejection of personal responsibility, and prioritizes union interests over the stability that families depend on for essential services.
